name: Serverless GPU & LLM Inference Benchmark - container cold start comparison (Sep 2026)
notes: Updated September 2026, carries its own disclosure: 'Disclosure: some links on this page are affiliate links (marked as such). If you sign up through them we may earn a commission, at no extra cost to you. This never influences our testing methodology or rankings.' CONTAINS A KNOWN WRONG NUMBER, recorded here so it is not reused: it lists 'Replicate A100 (80GB) median cold start 6.5 s', which contradicts Replicate's own per-second pricing page already in this corpus (ppl-cloud-replicate-pricing, accessed 2026-10-04) - per-second billing of a private model implies cold start is billed, and 6.5 s for a 70B-class weights pull from remote storage is not credible on its own terms. Their other figures: Modal A100 40GB ~1.8 s ('Modal uses custom containerization primitives allowing image memory snapshots to restore in under 2 seconds'), RunPod A100 80GB ~4.2 s, Together AI 'Instant (Pooled)', Lambda Labs 'On-Demand VM, no scale-to-zero (billed per hour)'. Their own summary of the shape of the problem, useful: the ~1.8 s figures are IMAGE-RESTORE times, not model-serving cold starts - no model weight load is included. Use this source for the shape (serverless cold start is dominated by image restore plus weight load, not by container start) not for the numbers.
